question: The International Day of Light is observed on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**16th May**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The International Day of Light **is celebrated on **16 May each year**.
 
• It is the **anniversary **of the **first successful operation **of the **laser in 1960**.
 
• By **physicist and engineer**, **Theodore Maiman**.
 
• This day is a **call to strengthen scientific cooperation **and **harness **its potential to **foster peace and sustainable development**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The laser **is a **prime illustration **of how a **scientific breakthrough **may help society in areas such as **communications**, **healthcare**, and **many others**.
 
• **This year **this **annual event is celebrated **on the **themes of Basic Sciences for Sustainable Development and Glass**.
 
• **Theodore Harold Maiman **was an **American engineer **and **physicist **who is widely credited **with the invention of the laser**.
 
• **Maiman's laser **led to the **subsequent development **of **many other types of lasers**.
 
• **The laser **was **successfully fired **on **May 16, 1960**.
